name.en: Fake India Post SMS: “parcel at warehouse, update your address in 48 hours”

how.en: A text claiming to be India Post says your parcel reached the warehouse but could not be delivered because the address was incomplete. It gives 12, 24 or 48 hours to update the address through a link, or the parcel will be returned. The link opens a look-alike India Post site that asks for personal details and a small “redelivery fee” by card, stealing card details and OTPs. India Post does not send links asking you to update your address.

text.en: An SMS says India Post could not deliver a parcel because of an incomplete address.
It says the parcel will be returned unless you act within hours.
It links to a page that looks like India Post.
The page asks for card details and a small fee or OTP.
IndiaPost: Delivery of your item failed as the house number is missing. Update the address within 12 hours to avoid return to sender: [link] Team India Post

Track a real article only on the India Post website or app with its tracking number.
If you paid or entered card details, call your bank and 1930.
